Senses.Explanation: The grassless place of ten thousand miles. Because the headword is the destination inside Dongshan's close-of-retreat charge, most windows carry it in the quoted case; the retained witnesses are the masters whose own turns deploy the exchange. Dahui Zonggao, recalling how the whole age's answers failed the charge and Shishuang's grass-at-the-door won Dongshan's Liuyang-ancient-buddha praise, supplies the analysis in his own voice: Dongshan's order to the grassless place is the question on the principle side — answer it there with dead words and it dies on one side — which is why Shishuang answered on the fact side. Hongzhi Zhengjue, raising the charge and its two answers, rules on the whole exchange: out the door is grass — one wades the thick-springing tangle, leaves falling to announce autumn, dropping into the dark green — and here one must catch the mechanism where the lock turns but the seal is not yet formed. Shiyu Mingfang stacks all three old lines — the grassless destination, the grass at the door, the grass even indoors — and rules they leave you no move at all, only because you cannot walk among the other-kind; then counts on his fingers chicken, dog, pig, goat, ox, horse — and asks why the seventh, human, goes unsaid. And Binya Jian, having raised the same triple, types the three old men like smugglers: one an eagle-hearted goose-clawed type who can say it but not do it, one a tiger-faced bear-livered type who can do it but not say it, one lying in the bramble thicket with no hope of standing up. Shenfeng Xian, at his own summer's close, turns the charge against the assembly: brambles cover the ground under your heels — to set out for the grassless ten thousand miles is very hard, very hard; wear out pairs of straw sandals and you still never leave this spot — better to keep to one's original portion. Lianfeng Su, raising the three worthies, rules they plucked one blade of grass out of a clean white ground and tripped up countless wandering monks — so he, seeing injustice on the road, pokes one spark from the stove to burn the blade and spare the dharma-hall a deeper grass. Chulin Shangrui, after the charge, the door-grass and Dongshan's how-many-in-the-great-Tang cry, answers the whole thing in verse: the grassless ten thousand miles — in the vast universe, travelers are few; out the door it is grass — falling flowers, flowing water, birds crying; the imperial way shows its honor without favor, and the drum-bellied singers of its peace have grown old. And Miyun Yuanwu, raising the charge at his own retreat's end, refuses it with replacement: Yumen today does not ask east-going or west-going — go to where withered wood flowers, go to where the icy river flames — then snatches up the staff: when you meet someone, by all means do not miss the mark; throws the staff, shouts, and descends.
